description: Office Wave 3 C3 — companion Quick Capture window (label `companion`, created by the open_companion_window command, boots /companion). Grants only what that window's minimal UI needs beyond the app-commands capability: the core JS event API so Send can emitTo('main', 'shannon:companion-prompt', …) — the cross-window channel into the main window's composer draft bridge. Window always-on-top toggling deliberately does NOT use the plugin:window JS API (that would need a core:window grant here); it goes through the Rust set_companion_always_on_top app command instead, keeping this capability event-only.
